title: Pure Vanquish Soul
summary: Pure Vanquish Soul fighting-game strategy, powered by a cast of DARK, EARTH, and FIRE warriors that reveal hidden combinations of Attributes in hand to execute devastating martial arts techniques. The deck fluidly tags heavy hitters in and out of the hand during either player's turn to control the field.

summary.title: Starters
points: Vanquish Soul Razen searches a non-Warrior Vanquish Soul monster upon summon, and reveals FIRE to gain destruction immunity or FIRE + DARK to destroy all other monsters in its column.

Vanquish Soul Dr. Mad Love searches a Vanquish Soul Spell or Trap upon summon, and reveals DARK to lower an enemy monster's ATK/DEF by 500 or DARK + EARTH to return the monster with the lowest DEF to the hand.

Vanquish Soul, Start! is the Field Spell that reveals a monster to search a Vanquish Soul with a different Attribute, protects your monsters from destruction by revealing, and Sets a Vanquish Soul Trap during the End Phase.
Stake your Soul! reveals a monster in hand to Special Summon a Vanquish Soul with the same Attribute but a different name directly from your Deck.
Vanquish Soul Jiaolong Special Summons itself from hand whenever you reveal cards for a Vanquish Soul effect, and reveals 2 FIRE to search any Vanquish Soul card.
Vanquish Soul Hollie Sue reveals EARTH to summon itself, and reveals combinations to summon from Deck or steal an opponent's monster.

summary.title: Opening: Razen + Stake your Soul!
steps: Normal Summon Vanquish Soul Razen; activate its on-summon effect to search Vanquish Soul Heavy Borger (DARK).
Link Summon Rock of the Vanquisher using Vanquish Soul Razen.
Activate Rock of the Vanquisher during the opponent's turn to Special Summon Vanquish Soul Razen from your hand.
Razen triggers on summon to add Vanquish Soul Caesar Valius (EARTH) to your hand, assembling all three core Attributes.
Bounce Razen to hand during the Main Phase to Special Summon Heavy Borger or Caesar Valius.

summary.title: Tag Mechanics & Attribute Techniques
points: Vanquish Soul Heavy Borger returns a non-Machine Vanquish Soul you control to hand as a Quick Effect to Special Summon itself, and reveals DARK to draw 1 card or DARK + FIRE to burn for 1500 damage.

Vanquish Soul Caesar Valius returns a non-Dragon Vanquish Soul you control to hand as a Quick Effect to Special Summon itself, and reveals EARTH to become immune to activated effects or EARTH + FIRE + DARK to destroy 1 other card on the field without targeting.
Rock of the Vanquisher is a Link-1 that either Special Summons a Vanquish Soul monster from your hand or adds a Vanquish Soul from your GY to your hand as a Quick Effect.
Vanquish Soul Rocks is a Rank 4 Xyz that inherits the Attributes of its materials and can detach to trigger destruction effects matching those Attributes.
Vanquish Soul Pantera Special Summons itself to an empty column, and reveals EARTH to avoid battle destruction or EARTH + FIRE to destroy all Spells and Traps in its column.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Vanquish Soul Snow Devil reveals up to three Attributes: revealing FIRE inflicts damage, revealing EARTH protects your Vanquish Souls from effect destruction, and revealing DARK destroys all other face-up monsters on the field.
Vanquish Soul Calamity Caesar is a Counter Trap that negates a targeting Spell, Trap, or monster effect by revealing a Vanquish Soul monster in hand and destroys it.
Vanquish Soul Dust Devil changes face-up monsters on the field to face-down Defense Position up to the number of Vanquish Soul monsters you control with different names.
Vanquish Soul - Continue? pays 500 LP to recover a Vanquish Soul from GY to hand or Special Summon it in Defense Position.

main: FIRE starter: searches a non-Warrior Vanquish Soul monster when summoned.
DARK starter: searches a Vanquish Soul Spell/Trap when summoned.
FIRE: summons itself when you reveal for a Vanquish Soul effect; searches with 2 FIRE.
Limited. EARTH: summons itself by revealing; summons a Vanquish Soul from the Deck or steals a monster.
EARTH: summons itself with an empty Main Monster Zone; clears Spells/Traps in its column.
EARTH Dragon: tags in for a non-Dragon on either turn; destroys a card with all three Attributes.
DARK Machine: tags in for a non-Machine; draws or burns.
FIRE: summons itself on their turn as a wall or a 3000 ATK swing.
Newest Field Spell: searches a monster of a different Attribute, protects by revealing, sets a Trap.
Reveals a monster to summon a same-Attribute Vanquish Soul from the Deck.
Adds or revives a Vanquish Soul monster from the GY.
Counter Trap: negates targeting and burns.
Reveals up to three Attributes: burn, protection, then a board wipe.
Summons two more Vanquish Soul from the hand and bounces their column.
extra: Link-1: summons a Vanquish Soul from the hand or returns one from the GY on either turn.
Newest Rank 4: gains effects from its materials' Attributes, including a destroy.
